description: In a dramatic break with their own party, a coalition of Republican officeholders and community leaders — led by former Congressman Dan Miller and Commissioner George Kruse — publicly endorsed Democrat Kelly Kirschner for Congress.
title: Prominent Republicans Cross Party Lines to Endorse Democrat Kelly Kirschner for Congress: “He Cares About 850,000 Residents of District 16, Not Just One Resident of the White House.” - Kelly Kirschner for U.S. Congress - FL 16
